mapper.select: SELECT id, family_id, name, type, amount, category_id, sub_category_id, account_id, period_type, period_value, start_date, end_date, enabled, last_processed_date, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM recurring_rule WHERE deleted = 0 AND enabled = 1 AND start_date <= #{today} ORDER BY family_id, id
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_rule SET last_processed_date = #{processedDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE recurring_rule SET name = #{r.name}, type = #{r.type}, amount = #{r.amount}, category_id = #{r.categoryId}, sub_category_id = #{r.subCategoryId}, account_id = #{r.accountId}, period_type = #{r.periodType}, period_value = #{r.periodValue}, start_date = #{r.startDate}, end_date = #{r.endDate}, enabled = #{r.enabled}, last_processed_date = #{r.lastProcessedDate} WHERE id = #{r.id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE recurring_rule SET enabled = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND created_by = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND enabled = 1
UPDATE recurring_rule SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND deleted = 0
